compositionBoundary: Consumes a provider-compiled exact context bundle; selects only duties borne by the named office; conveys neither office incumbency nor execution or customer authority.
receipt: Content-addressed selection binding actor, office, move, demand, session, context compilation receipt, selected duties, and warrant evidence.
refusal: Refuse foreign actors or offices, inexact bundles, unknown evidence signals, empty selections, and any signal selecting a duty absent from the office.
